author: Fettah010
name: WinUI 3 MVVM list/details page (i18n + responsive)
description: List/details Page + code-behind (INavigationAware, live loc bindings, responsive two-column) + transient ViewModel (selection + empty state) + MSTest stub + strings snippet. After scaffolding: paste SamplePage.strings.md into Services/Localization (then delete it), register the ViewModel, add the route - or run Scripts/add-page.ps1 -Kind list once and skip every manual step (see docs/TEMPLATE-GUIDE.md).

title.description: Page title: seeds the en-US strings in the snippet (XAML binds live via {loc:Loc}; es/fr ship as TODO-translate in the strings snippet).

route.description: Lowercase navigation route. Use a unique route per page; add-page.ps1 validates the route before wiring it.

icon.description: Nav icon, a WinUI Symbol member (choice list guarantees validity). The value is also exposed as ViewModel.NavSymbol.
